55: /**
56:  * Handles the {@code @UtilityClass} annotation for javac.
57:  */
58: @HandlerPriority(-4096) //-2^12; to ensure @FieldDefaults picks up on the 'static' we set here.
59: @Provides
60: public class HandleUtilityClass extends JavacAnnotationHandler<UtilityClass> {
61: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<UtilityClass> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
62: 		changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
63: 	}
64: 
65: 	private void changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
66: 		FlagUsageType utilityClassFlag = errorNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE);
67: 		FlagUsageType experimentalFlag = errorNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.EXPERIMENTAL_FLAG_USAGE);
68: 		FlagUsageType flaggedUsage = null;
69: 		String flaggedFeature = null;
70: 		if (utilityClassFlag == FlagUsageType.ERROR) {
71: 			flaggedUsage = utilityClassFlag;
72: 			flaggedFeature = "@UtilityClass";
73: 		} else if (experimentalFlag == FlagUsageType.ERROR) {
74: 			flaggedUsage = experimentalFlag;
75: 			flaggedFeature = "any lombok.experimental feature";
76: 		} else if (utilityClassFlag == FlagUsageType.WARNING) {
77: 			flaggedUsage = utilityClassFlag;
78: 			flaggedFeature = "@UtilityClass";
79: 		} else {
80: 			flaggedUsage = experimentalFlag;
81: 			flaggedFeature = "any lombok.experimental feature";
82: 		}
83: 		if (flaggedUsage != null) {
84: 			String flaggedMessage = "Use of " + flaggedFeature + " is flagged according to lombok configuration.";
85: 			if (flaggedUsage == FlagUsageType.WARNING) errorNode.addWarning(flaggedMessage);
86: 			else if (flaggedUsage == FlagUsageType.ERROR) errorNode.addError(flaggedMessage);
87: 		}
88: 		if (utilityClassFlag == null && AllowHelper.isAllowable(ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE)) {
89: 			errorNode.addError("Use of @UtilityClass is disabled by default. Please add '" + ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE.getKeyName() + " = " + FlagUsageType.ALLOW + "' to 'lombok.config' if you want to enable is.");
90: 		}
91: 
92: 		if (!inNetbeansEditor(errorNode) && errorNode.shouldDeleteLombokAnnotations()) {
93: 			JavacNode annotatedNode = errorNode.directUp();
94: 			if (annotatedNode.getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
95: 				try {
96: 					JCClassDecl annotatedType = (JCClassDecl) annotatedNode.get();
97: 					ListBuffer<JCAnnotation> remainingAnnotations = new ListBuffer<JCAnnotation>();
98: 					for (JCAnnotation existingAnnotation : annotatedType.mods.annotations) {
99: 						if (existingAnnotation != errorNode.get()) remainingAnnotations.append(existingAnnotation);
100: 					}
101: 					annotatedType.mods.annotations = remainingAnnotations.toList();
102: 				} catch (ClassCastException ex) {
103: 					// something rather odd has been annotated. Better to just break only delombok instead of everything.
104: 				}
105: 				annotatedNode.getAst().setChanged();
106: 				deleteImportFromCompilationUnit(errorNode, UtilityClass.class.getName());
107: 			}
108: 		}
109: 
110: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
111: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
112: 			return;
113: 		}
114: 
115: 		JavacNode typeWalk = typeNode;
116: 		while (true) {
117: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
118: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
119: 			case TYPE:
120: 				JCClassDecl typeDef = (JCClassDecl) typeWalk.get();
121: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
122: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) break;
123: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass automatically makes the class static, however, this class cannot be made static.");
124: 				return;
125: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
126: 				break;
127: 			default:
128: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass cannot be placed on a method local or anonymous inner class, or any class nested in such a class.");
129: 				return;
130: 			}
131: 			break;
132: 		}
133: 
134: 		JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
135: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
136: 		classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
137: 
138: 		boolean markStatic = true;
139: 		if (typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) markStatic = false;
140: 		if (markStatic && typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
141: 			JCClassDecl typeDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.up().get();
142: 			if ((typeDecl.mods.flags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0) markStatic = false;
143: 		}
144: 		if (markStatic) classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
145: 
146: 		for (JavacNode element : typeNode.down()) {
147: 			if (element.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
148: 				JCVariableDecl fieldDecl = (JCVariableDecl) element.get();
149: 				long fieldFlags = fieldDecl.mods.flags;
150: 				long staticFieldFlags = fieldFlags | Flags.STATIC;
151: 				fieldDecl.mods.flags = staticFieldFlags;
152: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.METHOD) {
153: 				JCMethodDecl methodDecl = (JCMethodDecl) element.get();
154: 				if (methodDecl.name.contentEquals("<init>")) {
155: 					if (getGeneratedBy(methodDecl) == null && (methodDecl.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) == 0) {
156: 						element.addError("@UtilityClasses cannot have declared constructors.");
157: 						makeConstructor = false;
158: 						continue;
159: 					}
160: 				}
161: 				long methodFlags = methodDecl.mods.flags;
162: 				long staticMethodFlags = methodFlags | Flags.STATIC;
163: 				methodDecl.mods.flags = staticMethodFlags;
164: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
165: 				JCClassDecl innerClassDecl = (JCClassDecl) element.get();
166: 				long innerFlags = innerClassDecl.mods.flags;
167: 				long staticInnerFlags = innerFlags | Flags.STATIC;
168: 				innerClassDecl.mods.flags = staticInnerFlags;
169: 				ClassSymbol innerClassSymbol = innerClassDecl.sym;
170: 				if (innerClassSymbol != null) {
171: 					if (innerClassSymbol.type instanceof ClassType) {
172: 						((ClassType) innerClassSymbol.type).setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
173: 					}
174: 				}
175: 			}
176: 		}
177: 
178: 		if (makeConstructor) {
179: 			JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
180: 			JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(Flags.PRIVATE, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
181: 			Name name = typeNode.toName("<init>");
182: 			JCExpression exceptionType = genJavaLangTypeRef(typeNode, "UnsupportedOperationException");
183: 			List<JCExpression> noTypeArgs = List.nil();
184: 			JCExpression message = maker.Literal("This is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
185: 			List<JCExpression> exceptionArgs = List.of(message);
186: 			JCExpression exceptionInstance = maker.NewClass(null, noTypeArgs, exceptionType, exceptionArgs, null);
187: 			JCStatement throwStatement = maker.Throw(exceptionInstance);
188: 			List<JCStatement> constructorBody = List.of(throwStatement);
189: 			JCBlock block = maker.Block(0L, constructorBody);
190: 			List<JCTypeParameter> noTypeParams = List.nil();
191: 			List<JCVariableDecl> noParams = List.nil();
192: 			List<JCExpression> noThrown = List.nil();
193: 			JCMethodDecl methodDef = maker.MethodDef(mods, name, null, noTypeParams, noParams, noThrown, block, null);
194: 			JCMethodDecl constructor = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodDef, typeNode);
195: 			injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
196: 		}
197: 	}
198: }

part.text:
The fix is complete and validated.

**Changes:**

1. `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleUtilityClass.java:171` — when `@UtilityClass` marks an inner class as static, also reset the cached erasure of the inner class symbol (`innerClassSymbol.erasure_field = null`). The stale erasure still referenced the pre-static enclosing type (`Converter.this`-style outer instance type with a null `sym`), which made javac's inference (when resolving the overloaded `convert`/`convertValue` calls) crash with an NPE in `Types.asSuper` on Java 11+.

2. `src/stubs/com/sun/tools/javac/code/Symbol.java:28` — added the `erasure_field` field to the javac `Symbol` stub lombok compiles against.

**Validation:** `ant test.instance` (runs `lombok.transform.TestWithDelombok`) → 384 tests run, 0 failures/errors, including the previously failing `javac-UtilityClassGeneric.java`, and all other UtilityClass tests still pass.
